fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Everyone Carries Subpersonalities", "body": "Zinser, a psychologist retired after 40 years of practice, describes how the psyche meets trauma by creating ego states or subpersonalities that take over to protect the self, then slip back into the unconscious once things are safe. He insists these parts are conscious beings that can communicate and live in a narrow reality, an idea he says mainstream psychology finds hard to accept. Asked about a social media trend of young people claiming dissociative identity disorder, he says he did not know it as a trend and frames multiplicity as a spectrum: everyone has subpersonalities, but only in the extreme do they take over the executive function."}, {"title": "Stuck in an Eternal Present", "body": "A subpersonality, Zinser says, lives in an eternal present, conscious only of the time and place where it split off and unaware of its own free choice or of any other world. When a later event touches the same fear or anger, the original part can be triggered, come forward and take on the body's new age, so a part formed at four may present at seven or twelve, or a new part may form with a vibratory link to the first, leaving groups of ego states living together. Once contacted, he says, they can be caught up to date, since they perceive and learn though they are not creative."}, {"title": "Light Offered but Never Forced", "body": "Zinser relays Gerod's description of the higher self as a piece the soul sends into the present incarnation, aware of this life and past lives and able to bring light, love and energy to wounded parts. The catch, he says, is that subpersonalities share the soul's free choice, so a frightened or angry part can stop that light and the light will not override it, which is where blocks come from. Using ideomotor finger signals under hypnosis, he asks each part to agree to receive the light, and he reports that nearly every part that accepts becomes cooperative, shares what it carried once, releases it and integrates."}, {"title": "Where the Fragments Live", "body": "Zinser says most subpersonalities are created in a bodily experience and carry its physical side, and they can say where in the body they sit; one group, he recounts, moved out of a client's elbow after a Rolfing session disturbed them, and badly threatened parts may leave the body for the aura. Past lives add a layer: Gerod told him the soul tucks unresolved parts into a protective pocket as it returns to the light, and that pocket can open in a later incarnation when a present issue matches the old one. Chance hears an echo of the stuck energy he finds in the field with biofield tuning."}, {"title": "Why the Client Leads the Healing", "body": "Zinser admits it is hard to work on your own subpersonalities, since they were created to keep their experience from the conscious self and healing asks them to do what they were made not to do. That is why he speaks to each part directly and explains that its sharing happens only once; doing that on yourself means wearing two hats at once. The process is client-directed and experiential, the practitioner only guiding, which Chance welcomes as a guard against a hypnotist's biases. Zinser began training practitioners after retiring, in a program of at least two years, and says his current third group is the last he will train personally."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: What if the inner critic, the anxious loop, and the self-saboteur are not personality traits but conscious fragments of a past self still living inside the moment of their creation? Dr. Thomas Zinser spent 15 years developing soul-centered healing alongside the spirit guide Gerod to answer exactly that question.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: Dr. Thomas Zinser, retired psychologist, hypnotherapist, and author of Soul-Centered Healing, joins InnerVerse to cover the creation of ego states during trauma and how they persist as conscious, autonomous fragments frozen in an eternal traumatic present, the higher self as the soul's active link to present incarnation, the ideomotor response protocol for communicating with sub-personalities and guiding them to receive light-love energy from the higher self, how sub-personalities are located in specific chakras and aura layers and can leave the body entirely for protection, pre-birth and past life sub-personalities carried across reincarnations, and the difference between authentic dissociation and what Chance sees as a social media DID trend.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Three Kinds of Attaching Spirits", "body": "In the extended hour Zinser lays out the taxonomy Jared gave him: earthbound spirits who stayed near the physical out of fear of judgment or attachment to family, mischievous spirits who know they could go to the light but linger to mess with people, and dark souls who continued in darkness after the body died. Even the darkest of them are still souls of light, he explains, and because incarnate humans are stepped-down light energy, these entities can draw on living people without facing the full light directly."}, {"title": "How Dark Souls Gain Access", "body": "Zinser identifies subpersonalities as the primary vulnerability that gives intruding spirits their opening, since dark souls communicate with these wounded parts below the level of consciousness. Because every fragment shares the soul's free choice, nothing can force its way in; instead a dark soul offers help, comfort or power to a part already in pain, and Jared calls the resulting consent a backhanded agreement. An accepted gift, like a doll offered to a frightened child ego state, becomes a door and a device, and Chance connects this to concealed objects he has found left in his own belongings by black magic practitioners."}, {"title": "Devices That Outlast a Lifetime", "body": "Asked whether these doorways can follow a person into the next incarnation, Zinser offers good news and bad. An attached spirit must vacate when its host dies and the soul goes to the light, and no dark soul can track a soul into the light itself. Devices planted within the soul, however, can pass through dormant and reactivate in a later life, and around a pregnancy or a newborn a dark soul can send out a pinging energy, reading a familiar response as a soul it has had contact with before and moving to reestablish its access or its energy drain."}, {"title": "Perfect but Not Complete", "body": "Zinser relays Jared's cosmology: all souls were created at once out of the light, perfect but not complete, and each must leave the light for a first experience of what it is not to begin its awakening. When the newly created souls began expanding, the darkness that light itself came out of reacted, and the light agreed to create the physical plane as a level playing field where every soul freely chooses between them. Within that frame Jared defines evil precisely, not as darkness, which is a natural struggle, but as one soul violating the free choice of another."}, {"title": "Fifteen Years With Jared", "body": "Pressed for the fuller story of his spirit guide, Zinser recalls the bookkeeper in his office, Katherine, who offered him a session with the entity she had first channeled at eighteen and shut down in fear. A Saturday morning session of automatic writing grew into a weekly collaboration from 1987 devoted strictly to healing, with Jared supplying insight on blocked clients for fifteen years before the work reached the edge of the metaphysical and stopped. Zinser now sees his life in three fifteen year arcs: the Jared years, the writing of his books, and bringing the work to the public."}]

fields.Plus Quotes JSON: [{"text": "There's earthbound spirits, those people like ourselves whose body has died, and they did not go to the light for a number of reasons.", "author": "Thomas Zinser", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/7c494919-a56c-4296-8e57-57d71d94c1ff/THOMAS-ZINSER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "As Jared said, we here in the physical are stepped-down light energy, and these spirits can access that without being threatened by the light full on.", "author": "Thomas Zinser", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/7c494919-a56c-4296-8e57-57d71d94c1ff/THOMAS-ZINSER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "The only judgment in the light is a soul judging itself. It's not being judged by God or by some court.", "author": "Thomas Zinser", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/7c494919-a56c-4296-8e57-57d71d94c1ff/THOMAS-ZINSER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Jared said all souls were created at once of light, and that all souls were perfect but not complete.", "author": "Thomas Zinser", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/7c494919-a56c-4296-8e57-57d71d94c1ff/THOMAS-ZINSER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I think that the balance is tipping towards the light, although it might not seem that way looking at society or looking at world events. I think that darkness has better PR.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I kind of look at everything through the lens of what's the most fun experience, what's got the most payoff for a spirit.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "If we knew coming down here in incarnation, and we came out knowing we were part of the light, that's game over. Why would I want to do anything else?", "author": "Thomas Zinser", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/7c494919-a56c-4296-8e57-57d71d94c1ff/THOMAS-ZINSER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "One thing about victim consciousness is there's always a bigger boogeyman.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Jared said that things become evil when one soul violates the free choice of another, and that is crossing the line.", "author": "Thomas Zinser", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/7c494919-a56c-4296-8e57-57d71d94c1ff/THOMAS-ZINSER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Because of all this association of evil and darkness, people will often start to believe of themselves that they're somehow twisted or wrong or evil, but maybe they're just going through a dark time.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "I have come to trust that the most profound healing is provided by the power of epiphany.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "This is the part that's so difficult to understand in terms of mainstream psychology, that there is actually other parts of ourselves that are conscious and alive.", "author": "Thomas Zinser", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/7c494919-a56c-4296-8e57-57d71d94c1ff/THOMAS-ZINSER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "At one level, we all have subpersonalities. Nobody gets through life unscathed.", "author": "Thomas Zinser", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/7c494919-a56c-4296-8e57-57d71d94c1ff/THOMAS-ZINSER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "You can interpret life the way you would interpret a dream, and that the meaning and the teleology of it is going to be there in exactitude.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "These ego states, from my point of view, they not only influence the self. Depending on who they are, what they carry, what's happened, they can very strongly direct the self.", "author": "Thomas Zinser", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/7c494919-a56c-4296-8e57-57d71d94c1ff/THOMAS-ZINSER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "As Gerod said, the soul will take those unresolved parts and put them in a pocket within the soul, protecting them from the light.", "author": "Thomas Zinser", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/7c494919-a56c-4296-8e57-57d71d94c1ff/THOMAS-ZINSER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "All that exists is the light and life and incarnation and reality and expansion and flow and beauty and truth and love.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "The thing I would emphasize is the healing process is directed by the client. We work with what they present. We don't go calling things forward.", "author": "Thomas Zinser", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/7c494919-a56c-4296-8e57-57d71d94c1ff/THOMAS-ZINSER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
